title: MotionCoach: Constructing Multimodal Guidance for Video Professional Motion Editing
abstract: Video editing models achieve strong performance in modifying appearance, backgrounds, styles, and motions, empowered by large-scale training data. Beyond general scenarios, professional motions are significant in performance, sports, and martial arts. This paper focuses on professional motion editing, which involves fine-grained motion technique and temporal structure. Given professional motion names but lacking detailed descriptions, existing models often fail to generate professional motions, such as incorrectly lifting the front wheel under a Stoppie instruction. To address this challenge, we introduce MotionCoach, a trained multimodal agent that uses multi-turn tools and performs self-verification, producing a grounded prompt and a reference clip as reliable and sufficient multimodal guidance to inject external professional motion knowledge into video editing models. To supply training data, we build a data pipeline to construct trajectories. We cold-start the agent on MotionCoach-SFT-10k and apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on MotionCoach-RL-2k with rewards on the motion guidance prompt, the motion outcome video, and the format. For evaluation, we introduce VPMEBench, comprising 314 professional motion editing tasks with fine-grained references and annotations. Extensive experiments show that MotionCoach improves the overall score from 55.1 to 65.6 on Seedance 2.0 and from 51.2 to 64.5 on MiniMax-H3. Learning to construct multimodal guidance enables precise professional motion editing without retraining video editing models.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.12963v1 的 23 页全文与关键图表核验整理。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。
analysis.ideaZh: MotionCoach 训练 Qwen3-VL agent 从动作名称获取演示、裁剪并自检参考，再输出 grounded prompt+clip 驱动冻结视频编辑器；SFT后用prompt/video/format rewards做GRPO。作者报告 Seedance整体55.1→65.6、MiniMax51.2→64.5；适合研究生成工具前的知识获取闭环。专业动作正确性仍不高（MP53.0/33.1），视觉物理评分不等于真实动力学验证。
analysis.motivationZh: 专业或罕见动作名无法提供足够的姿态、阶段和接触细节，video editor 容易保留原动作或生成相近但错误的动作。需要找到匹配的运动参考，并把参考转成可用的编辑指导，同时保留源视频的其他内容。
analysis.methodZh: 目标是纠正仅给罕见动作名时编辑器保留原动作或生成混淆动作的问题。Agent从source和instruction提取motionquery，search前三候选、查看完整演示、裁剪不超过5s，显式selfcheck并reclip/reselect；输出按dense timeline/sparse stages/key state组织的专业mechanics和sourcepreservation条件。Policy全量SFT10k、RL2k，冻结MiniMax生成rolloutvideo提供outcomereward，评测用独立Gemini与domainexpertpairwiseaudit。
methodFlow: 构造动作guidance训练数据：采源视频和经多模型/web核实的atomicmotionnames；Geminiteacher生成search/inspect/clip/selfchecktrajectories，VLM+programmatic+humanspotcheck。
检索并查看专业演示：Query保留domain与精确motion；tool返回3候选的name/title/duration等，agent优先exactname再inspect完整视频。
剪辑与观察后修正：选≤5s可见完整动作，检查support/direction/keyphases与干扰，失败则重新剪辑或选择另一候选。
构造multimodalguidance：Verifiedclip与groundedprompt描述时序/力学和negativeconstraints；sourcevideo指定应保留服装、场景、camera和其他内容，编辑器权重冻结。
学习可执行guidance策略：SFT后GRPO综合prompt0.7、outcomevideo0.3以及formatreward，onlyagent更新；outcomejudge评motion/physicalplausibility/quality/preservation。
analysis.experimentsZh: VPMEBench314tasks（dance144/sports110/martial60）、25leafcategories，humanverified5sreference与1403keyframes/temporalannotations；training/benchmarkmotionnames、sourcevideos与pairedprompts声明disjoint。FrozenMiniMaxH3/Seedance2.0为主要结果，七editorbaseline用shortprompts，Gemini3.5Flash按0/.5/1judge，Overall=.5MP+.2PP+.3VQ。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告Seedance整体55.1→65.6，MP29.6→53.0、PP85.8→87.1、VQ77.1→72.2；MiniMax整体51.2→64.5、MP16.2→33.1。（PDF p.7 Table 1）；作者报告只groundedpromptSeedance59.8/MiniMax63.7、prompt+clip65.6/64.5、humanexpertguidance72.1/68.9；clip对MiniMax增益仅0.8整体points。（PDF p.7 Table 3）；作者报告无clipselect/无verify时overall分别Seedance57.4/58.1、MiniMax54.1/54.6。（PDF p.7 Table 4）；作者报告IVEBenchsubjectmotion子集Total48.0→53.8，但VTSS6.4→6.1、IS2.73→2.62，非每指标赢。（PDF p.9 Table 6） 对照范围：直接editor与同workflowuntrained9B/27Bpolicy、SFT与RL；训练8B胜untrained27B，且有expertguidanceupperreference。Shortpromptbaseline信息比reference+longprompt少，所以maingain既包含externalinformation又包含learnedworkflow，ablation可区分部分作用。 消融与诊断：SFT/RL、prompt/clip/experts、video/image、uniformclip、selfverify、rewardweights、toolcalls。MainproductionseedCI和完整guidance/endtoendinference成本缺失；human给preferenceagreementCI而非mainaccuracyCI。
analysis.insightZh: 有独立agent决策训练与真实frozeneditoroutcome反馈，贡献是可靠参考获取、自检和生成条件组织；不是只套promptworkflow。新benchmark用expertmotionconstraints评价，可研究外部knowledge如何进入生成工具，但仍主要以videojudging验证。
analysis.evidenceZh: 训练更新policy而不更新videoeditor，并使用生成outcome的RLreward。（PDF pp.5–6 §3.2–3.3, Eqs.(2)–(6); pp.22–23 Tables 11–12）；作者报告未训练workflow收益不稳定，SFT/RL与clipselfverify有效。（PDF p.7 Tables 2–5; pp.8–9 analysis）；独立expertpairwiseaudit支持自动排序，但不能当作绝对专业正确率。（PDF p.9 Table 9; p.12 Appendix A.1）；Sourcepreservation与专业mechanics有tradeoff，Seedance VQ下降。（PDF p.7 Table 1）；受控searchschema含候选的query_name与primarymotionname，并非验证任意网络搜索鲁棒性。（PDF pp.15–16 Appendix A.3.1）
analysis.caveatZh: Complexterrain的Gturn可不完整，细微localhiparticulation仍难准确；AppendixA.2给两failurecases。；Infrastructuregeneration/judging失败样本在RL排除；方法依赖可靠参考与frozeneditor执行guidance。；MP含0/.5/1partial，53.0不能称53%动作完全正确；PP是VLM对可见balance/contact判断，不验证物理参数或真实运动安全。；SeedanceVQ下降说明preservation和motioncorrectiontradeoff；生成器仍会失败，即使tooltrajectory99.7%成功也不等于motion成功。；Searchtop3结构化motionnames和referenceavailability可能简化检索；未验证任意新motion无候选环境。；Trainingoutcome通过sameeditor，transfer仅另一主要editor与有限unseen例；qualityjudge不是实测mechanics。；官方project未提供确认publicimplementation，training/inference开销和平台reference许可/可访问coverage需自行核查。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接研究agent调用视觉检索/剪辑工具、观察反馈与生成条件，在设计产物生成前补齐领域知识，符合visualdesignagentfocused方向；未直接研究CAD或fabrication。
